# Stadler Form Julia Diffuser, Metal

## Ultrasonic Mist for Your Space

The Stadler Form Julia Diffuser uses ultrasonic technology to blend water with pure essential oil and release a fine, gentle mist. Fill it, add your favorite scent, and let your room carry the aroma through the day.

## Run Time That Fits Your Routine

Choose continuous mode for up to 18 hours on low or 12 hours on high. Prefer a lighter rhythm? Interval mode (10 minutes on, 20 minutes off) extends run time to 54 hours on low or 36 hours on high, so one refill goes much further.

## Design That Suits Your Decor

Available in several vibrant colors, the Julia lets you match your shelf, table, or nightstand. Its compact, sleek profile looks at home in a bedroom, office, or living room.

## Peace of Mind Built In

An automatic shut-off stops the unit when the water runs out, so you can set it up and step away with confidence.

## Coverage for Medium Spaces

Designed for rooms up to 540 square feet, the Julia brings consistent scent to a single room or an open area.

## Add Your Favorite Scent Today

Pick your color, add your favorite essential oil, and bring a calming atmosphere to your space. Add the Stadler Form Julia Diffuser to your cart today.
